# Q11 quest handlers (daevanion, sanctum): generated files

## Phase 6 step 2, lane C (2026-10-08)

The 74 Java handlers (6,850 lines) of chunk Q11's two directories (`chunks.cmake`): daevanion (36, the Daevanion armour quests of both
races) and sanctum (38, the Elyos capital: campaign, class, craft and daily quests; levels 10-50). Branch `lane-c/p6-q11`, stacked on
`lane-c/p6-q13` (docs/deviations/Q13.md), worktree build `cpp/build/msvc` (Debug). Method: the earlier chunks' (questgen's output copied
unedited, `AION_QUEST_HANDLER` markers, the golden trace harness, `tools/parity`, the compile check; owner rules U1/U7), and, because
Sanctum is where several gate characters stand, the gate traffic measured before landing (phase6-transliterator.md §7.5; below).

| | Files |
|---|---|
| Generated by questgen (bannered, drift-tested) | **71** (daevanion 35, sanctum 36) |
| Hand-ported | 0 |
| Not in the tree | **3**: questgen refuses 2 (API gaps), 1 escort held back for FollowingNpcAI (below) |
| Held back for a gate | 0 (below, "Gate traffic") |

Every file is in `cpp/game-server/handlers/aion/gameserver/handlers/quest/<directory>/`, compiled into `aion_gs_handlers_quest_q11` (unity
build), and registers with `AION_QUEST_HANDLER`.

### Generator

No change. The corpus stays at 1,002 of 1,035. Two files carry questgen's marked Java bugs (KNOWN_JAVA_BUGS, kept by U3):
`sanctum/_3963GrowthFlorasThirdCharm` and `_3964GrowthFlorasFourthCharm` take the kinah twice (`tryDecreaseKinah` already took it,
Storage.java:82-88). No new Java bug was found.

### Not in the tree (3; reported, not ported)

- **`sanctum/_3212TheMissingCubeCraftsman`** (level 43): questgen transliterates it (rows B26-B30), but it is one of the six escorts of
  m5d-plan.md §21.1 whose follower AI ("following", FollowingNpcAI) has no C++ file: without it the follower neither walks nor respawns.
  Held back as pandaemonium/_4212 is (tools/gen/tests/test_questgen_escorts.py requires the six to stay out of the tree); it lands when
  FollowingNpcAI does. Not a gate matter.

- **`daevanion/_1990ASagesGift`**: `player.getGameStats().getMaxDp().getCurrent()` (`_1990ASagesGift.java:69`). **An API gap**: questgen
  scans neither the player's game stats nor `Stat2`; a later row (Player.getGameStats, PlayerGameStats.getMaxDp, Stat2.getCurrent) would
  close it if C++ declares the three.
- **`sanctum/_1929ASliverofDarkness`**: `Equipment.getEquippedItemsAllStigma` and `Equipment.unEquipItem` (`:282`, `:293`). **An API
  gap**, left for a later row.

No missing shared-header member blocks a generated Q11 file.

### Generated files

Regenerate (from `cpp/`): `python -m tools.gen.questgen --dry-run --emit <dir outside the repo>` and copy the two directories'
`<dir>/aion/gameserver/handlers/quest/<directory>/*.cpp`. **No hand edit**: `tools/gen/tests/test_questgen_tree.py` regenerates every
bannered tree file and compares the bytes; its `Q11` table pins the 71 by name.

### Gate traffic (measured before landing)

Measured as P6-Q slice 2 measured gs.scenario.travel (p6q-ascension-route.md §8.3): a temporary, env-gated dump in the scenario client
(`GameSession::record`: every packet name of every client, and the bytes of SM_NEARBY_QUESTS, SM_QUEST_ACTION, SM_DIALOG_WINDOW,
SM_QUEST_LIST, SM_QUEST_COMPLETED_LIST), run on the seven gates whose characters stand in Sanctum (travel, ascension, m5c, m5e, m5e_geo,
m5f, m5f_geo), one at a time under the test-database lock, first on this branch without the 72 transliterated files, then with them
(3212, held back since, was among them; none of its quests is in the differences below); removed afterwards
(`git checkout` of the file, rebuilt, no `AION_P6Q_Q11_DUMP` string left in the build tree; never committed). All 14 runs passed.
Compared per gate (all clients together, the npc object id of SM_DIALOG_WINDOW left out, which differs between any two runs):

| Gate | Quest packets with the 72 |
|---|---|
| travel, ascension, m5c, m5f, m5f_geo | **SM_NEARBY_QUESTS in Sanctum names 8 more quests**: 1900, 1901, 1909, 1963, 3965, 3968, 19004, 19048 (before: 19040, 1910, 1911, 9510, and 1912 / 3910 in m5f); in ascension also a second list of the same quests with marker flag 2, as the list before had |
| m5e, m5e_geo | no difference |

Every SM_QUEST_ACTION, SM_DIALOG_WINDOW page, SM_QUEST_LIST and SM_QUEST_COMPLETED_LIST is the same with and without the 72. The other
count differences are fight and movement timing (SM_ATTACK, SM_MOVE, SM_STATUPDATE_HP vary in both directions between runs; one
SM_SYSTEM_MESSAGE more in ascension and one fewer in m5e, in fight sessions).

The new markers are Java's: the 72 handlers register the start npcs (`addOnQuestStart`) of those quests, which stand in Sanctum, and the
server builds the nearby-quest list from those registrations, as Java does (the same kind of change P6-Q slice 2 measured in Altgard). No gate checks them, so **no gate expectation
or seeded state was changed** (the owner's rule of 2026-09-29 would allow it; it was not needed), and nothing is held back.

- **Gates**: every gs.scenario.* gate (19), one at a time with the lock taken per gate (`gate_lock.py lane-C`), m5a_stress excluded, on
  the full Debug build of this branch (the 71, no dump): **19 of 19 passed** (7,957 s of wall time, lock waits included); every gate
  server logged "Loaded 4816 quest handlers" (4745 + the 71); no "QE: exception" line. No gate expectation was changed. (A run before
  3212 was held back, with 72, passed 19 of 19 too.)
